title: Hoop KIngs
description: Hoop Kings is a casual puzzle game where players aim to score points by solving basketball-themed challenges. With engaging gameplay, vibrant graphics, and a mix of strategy and fun, it’s perfect for quick entertainment or longer play sessions.
instructions: How to play Keyboard Use the arrow keys to swipe the ball left right up or down Touch Screen Swipe left right up or down to control the basketballs movement
